name: ENiShare v1.1.0
body:
ENiShare 1.1.0: share files between this PC and an iPhone over Wi-Fi, from Safari (no iPhone app).

## Install

- **Windows 10/11**: run `ENiShare-Setup-1.1.0.exe`. The installer is not code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may show *Windows protected your PC*; click *More info → Run anyway*.
- **Ubuntu 22.04+**: `sudo apt install ./enishare_1.1.0_amd64.deb`, or run `ENiShare-1.1.0-x86_64.AppImage`.

## What's new

- **Liquid Glass theme**: the accent colour at full strength as a wallpaper of 3D ribbons, with frosted glass panels, cards, buttons, switches and notices.
- Glass uses the light native theme for menus and scrollbars.
- Update notes show only what changed.
- The theme button moved into Settings → Appearance.

> Status: tested with a simulated iPhone (automated end-to-end test) and on Ubuntu. Real-iPhone and Windows testing is still in progress; see `docs/TESTING.md`.
